content: Chasna tucui tandaric runagunata ricusha Pablo rimangahua callarira, Uyaichi Israel huauquiguna, ñucaga cunan punzhagama Diospa ñaupacpi ali yuyaihuanmi causashcani nisha rimara.
Pablo chasna rimacpi chi Ananias nishca pagrigunahua jatun amuga, Pablohuan pariu tiyauc runagunata mandara, paihua shimibi huactaichi nisha.

Huactanaupi Pabloga Ananiasta randi rimara, Can chibi tiyaunguimi Moises mandashcashinalla taripangahua. Chasna ashallata mana mandashcashina churashcangui ñucata huactaichi nisha. Chasna rashami mana ali runa angui. Can chasna mana alita urdinashcamandami Dios randi canda huactanga.
Chibi tiyaucunaga Pablota rimanaura, Dios churashca jatun pagritachu mana alita rimangui.

Chasna rimacpi, Ñáuca mana yacharanichu pai cangunata mandauc jatun pagri acta, yachashca ashaga mana chasna rimaimacharani huauquiguna. Ñáuca yachani Diospa shimi nin: Cangunata mandaucunata ima mana ali shimita rimanguichichu nishcata yachanimi.
Chi tandarishca aucuna chaupi chaupi tucushshcamanda

Ñáa chi tandariushcaibi ishcai (2) muntun tiyanaura. Shuca cuti causarinata yuyaric fariseo nishcaguna. Shuca cuti causarinata mana yuyaric saduceo nishcaguna. Chi saduceogunaga runa huañusha mana cuti causarinachu niucuna, chasnallata angelguna illanmi, ayahuas almahuas illanmi niucuna. Astahuanbas fariseogunaga tucui caiguna tiyanmi niucuna. Chasna acpi Pablo ña paiguna ishcai (2) tunu yuyai acta yachasha sinzhi shimihuan uyangachun nisha rimara, Ñáuca fariseo mani huauquiguna. Ñáuca yayahuas fariseo mara. Runa huañushcamanda cuti causarinata ñuca quirishcamandami taripaitucuni. Pablo chasna rimacpi fariseo runagunahuan saduceo runagunahuan piñanacunaura. Piñanacusha chapu tucunaura.

Paigunapura sinzhita caparinaura. Chasna tucucpi maican Moises mandashcagunata yachachic fariseoguna shayarisha rimanaura, Cai runaga ima caudsatas mana charinzhu randi shuc angel shuc aya paita rimashcachari.

Paigunapura yapa piñanacusha Pablota tílma tílma aisasha huanchinata ricusha sundaluta mandac yapa manzharira. Chiraicu mandara sundaluguna chi runaguna maquimanda Pablota quichusha carcel ucuma cuti pushanauchun nisha.

Chi tutallatami Señor Jesusca Pablohuacpi ricurisha rimara, Ama manzharichu, ama llaquirisha tiyaichu Pablo. Can Jerusalen llactai ñucamanda rimashcacuinta cunan chi Roma llactaibihuas ñucamanda rimagringuimi nira.
Pablota huanchinata yuyariunguna
Cayandi punzha chuscu chunga (40) yali israel runaguna, Pablota huanchinagama ama upishun, ama micushun nisha yuyarisha paigunapura sirtu shimita rimanacunaura.
Chasna yuyarisha chi runaguna pagri amugunahuagma, rucugunahuagmas rimangahua rinaura, Ñáucanchi Diospacpi yuyarishcanchimi imatahuas mana micushun mana upishun Pablota huanchinagama nisha.

Cunanga casna ranguichi. Chi shuc taripaccunandi pariu tandariusha chi sundaluta mandacta rimaichi caya punzha Pablota pushamuchun cangunahuagma mas alita tapungahua nisha. Pai chara mana pactamugllaita ñucanchiga chaupibi chapasha huanchishun nisha rimanacunaura.
Chasna rimashcata uyasha Pablohua panihua churi chi carcelma yaicusha Pablota rimagrira.
Chasna rimagricpi Pablo shuc sundaluta mandacta cayasha, Cai musuta pushai canda mandagma, pai shuc cuintanata charinmi nira.
Chasna nicpi chi musuta apasha sundalugunata mandagma pactasha rimara, Chi tapashca Pablo ñucata cayasha nihuara cai musuta apasha ri pai shuc shimita cuintanata charinmi can uyachun nisha.
Chasna nicpi paiga Pablohua sobrinota maquimanda japisha isquinama pushasha tapura, Imatata ñucata cuintanata munangui.
Tapucpi chi musu nira, israelguna cuintanacunaushca canda tapungahua nisha caya punzha Pablota israel amuguna tandarina huasima apamuchun paimanda mas ashcata tapusha yachangahua nisha.

Randi paiguna tapushcataga ama ranguichu. Chuscu chunga (40) yali israelgunaga Diospacpi rimashca aunguna mana micushunzhu mana upishunzhu Pablota huanchinagama nisha. Chasna apamushcai paiguna huanchingahua chapaunguna nira.
Chasna tucuita cuintacpi chi musuta dispirisha, Ama pitahuas rimanguichu ñucanchi cuintashcata nisha cachara.

Dispirishcahuasha chi sundalugunata mandacca paimanda mas pishi ishcaigunata (2) cayasha mandara, sundalugunata alichichi Pablota Cesarea llactama apangahua. Ishcai patsac (200) chaquihuan puriucunas, canzhis chunga (70) caballoi puriucunas, ishcai patsac (200) espada saulihuan puriucunahuas tucuita alichisha chapanauchun las nueve tutai llucshisha Cesarea llactama ringahua.
Chasnallata Pablo rina caballogunatas alichichi gubirnadur Felix ñaupagma pai ali pactachun nisha mandara.
Chasna mandasha chigunahuan cachaura shuc quillcata casna nisha,
Ñáuca, Claudio Lisias, Ali jatun mandac amu Felixta saludauni.
Cai Pablo nishca runataga israelguna japisha huanchinata munanaura. Chasna acpi pai romano runa acta yachasha ñuca sundalugunahuan risha quishpichirani.
Imamandata casna huanchinata munaunguna nisha yachangahua israel amugunahuagma paita pushasha rirani.

Chibi ñuca asirtarani israelgunaga paiguna mandashca shimigunata Pablo mana pactachinzhu nishami caudsayachiushca anaura. Astahuanbas cai runa ñucahuacpi ima caudsayachinata mana charinzhu carcelbi tapaitucunatahuas, ima huañuna caudsatahuas.

Chasna agllaita rimahuashcami israelguna cai runataga huanchingahua chapaunguna nisha. Chasnamandami paita huairashina canma cachauni. Chasnallata chi caudsayachic runagunatas mandarani imatas caudsachinata munashaga cambacpi rimagrichi nisha. Chillata quillcasha dispirini.
Pablota mandac amu Felixma pushaunguna
Sundalugunaga paigunata mandac rimashcacuinta cadsusha Pablota chi tutallata pactachinaura Antipatris nishca llactagama.
Cayandi punzha chaquihuan riu sundalugunaga bulltianaura paiguna cuartelmallata. Randi caballoibi riu sundalugunaga Pablohuan mas rinaura.
Ñáa Cesareama pactasha mandac amu Felixma quillcata cunaura, chasnallata Pablota paihua maquibi saquinaura.
Chi amu quillcata ricushcahuasha Pablota tapura, Maican provinciamandatangui. Cilicia provinciamanda mani nicpi amu rimara,
Canda caudsayachiu runaguna shamucpi canmanda uyashami nira. Chihuasha paihua sundalugunata mandara Pablota cuiraichi nisha mandac amu Herodespa huasi ucui.
